coordinate_systems.blender: right-handed, Z up, X east, Y north
coordinate_systems.blender_to_roblox: (x, y, z) -> (x, z, -y); rotation around Blender Z by a == rotation around Roblox Y by a  => CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(0, rad(a), 0)
coordinate_systems.asset_origin: ground contact point of the asset; front (main door) faces Blender -Y = Roblox +Z
